fork.each_caveat: a .each or .skipIf/.runIf call counts once, however many cases it expands to at run time; a fixture alias created with test.extend is not counted.
fork.method: static TypeScript AST count of test/fork/**/*.test.ts at the git tree: every call expression whose callee is it/test or a property chain on it/test (.only .skip .todo .each .skipIf .runIf .concurrent ...); no Hardhat, no network, no import of any test file.

list_caveat: vitest list drops tests whose collected state is skipped (it.skip, it.todo, it.skipIf with a true condition); a file that fails collection makes it write no JSON at all, recorded here as a collection error.
post_rail_method:
vitest list --project

--json in the main checkout (railed by the project setupFiles and the preload)
pre_rail_method:
vitest list --project
